區於山也相其原野開闢之處聚一鄉之
民蠲其稅役而專戰鬭之習如新鄭立義
營之法可也或積盜得之資節其冗費以
給勇敢之士如安潛賞告捕之法亦可也
此亦一時應變之宜也非可恃以為安也
punctuated:
得一良部使者，如得勝兵三十萬人。此實有得於歐陽子之旨，而深切于八閩弭盜之防者與！故治山得一賈琮，則尺書移檄，而不患巷路之無歌；治海得一龔遂，則單車就道，而不患兵戈之不解。之二子者，非所謂勝兵者乎？雖然，其要在守令，其機在部使，而其權在朝廷。必也緩治盜而急治民，後催科而先撫字，而又躬儉約以憫民窮，秉權衡以平民志，燭幾微以悉民隱，廣孚惠以賙民乏，崇裕柔以亮民昧，則民將有生之樂，無死之虞，雖賞之不竊矣。所謂治心者，此也。
由是而猶有盜焉，則於海也，擇其水陸交會之區；於山也，相其原野開闢之處。聚一鄉之民，蠲其稅役，而專戰鬭之習，如新鄭立義營之法，可也。或積盜得之資，節其冗費，以給勇敢之士，如安潛賞告捕之法，亦可也。此亦一時應變之宜也，非可恃以為安也。
translation_en:
…To obtain one good regional commissioner is like obtaining three hundred thousand victorious troops. This truly grasps Master Ouyang’s meaning and bears directly upon measures to suppress banditry in the Eight Min regions of Fujian! Thus, to govern the mountains, obtain a Jia Cong: with a brief letter and a circulated proclamation, there will be no fear that songs of praise will be absent from the lanes and roads. To govern the coast, obtain a Gong Sui: he need only set out in a single carriage, and there will be no fear that armed conflict will persist. Are these two men not what is meant by victorious troops? Nevertheless, the essential work rests with prefects and county magistrates, its coordination with regional commissioners, and its authority with the imperial court. One must give less urgency to suppressing bandits and greater urgency to governing the people, putting tax collection after caring for them. One must also personally practice frugality out of compassion for their poverty, exercise impartial judgment to settle their minds, discern the slightest signs to understand their hidden sufferings, extend trustworthy beneficence to relieve their want, and uphold generosity and gentleness to enlighten their ignorance. Then the people will have the joy of living and no fear of death; even if rewarded for stealing, they will not steal. This is what is meant by governing their hearts.
If bandits still remain after this, select places along the coast where land and water routes meet, and in the mountains seek out places where the plains and fields are open. Gather the people of a township, exempt them from taxes and labor services, and have them devote themselves to training for combat. One may follow Xinzheng’s method of establishing militia camps. Alternatively, accumulate funds obtained from bandits [?], curtail unnecessary expenditures, and use the money to support brave men. One may also follow An Qian’s method of rewarding those who report and capture bandits. These, too, are measures appropriate for responding to immediate contingencies; they cannot be relied upon to secure lasting peace.

title: 嘉靖十三年福建鄉試錄
text:
故曰其要在守令今者數易之弊興而人
無積久之思文法之拘勝而人無精覈之
慮遇有難為輒自因循以貽其後而後復
如之則其害何時已也必在為部使者別
其賢愚量其大小果有可任則請之于
朝而分任之專責成之久成功者不次銓用
而淹留歲月坐享宴安者不與焉如是則
守必能行其志於郡令必能行其志於邑
而盜賊有不息者乎故曰其機在部使而
===
其權在
朝廷不然則
國家全盛之日豪傑竝興之時而無龔賈之
徒愚未之信也
punctuated: 故曰，其要在守令。今者數易之弊興，而人無積久之思；文法之拘勝，而人無精覈之慮。遇有難為，輒自因循以貽其後，而後復如之，則其害何時已也？必在為部使者別其賢愚，量其大小，果有可任，則請之于朝，而分任之專，責成之久。成功者不次銓用，而淹留歲月、坐享宴安者不與焉。如是，則守必能行其志於郡，令必能行其志於邑，而盜賊有不息者乎？故曰，其機在部使，而其權在朝廷。不然，則國家全盛之日，豪傑竝興之時，而無龔賈之徒，愚未之信也。
translation_en: Thus I say that the key lies with the prefects and magistrates. Today, the pernicious practice of frequent replacement has arisen, and officials give no thought to sustained service; constraints imposed by legal formalities prevail, and officials give no thought to meticulous investigation. Whenever they encounter something difficult to accomplish, they simply temporize and leave it to their successors, who do the same in turn. When, then, will the harm end? Those serving as provincial commissioners must distinguish the worthy from the foolish and assess the extent of their abilities. If they find someone truly fit to be entrusted with office, they should petition the court, give him undivided responsibility for his assigned duties, and allow him sufficient time to achieve results. Those who succeed should be appointed or promoted without regard to the regular order; those who merely let the years slip by, idly enjoying ease and comfort, should receive no such consideration. In this way, prefects will surely be able to carry out their intentions in their prefectures, and magistrates in their counties. How could banditry then fail to subside? Thus I say that the initiative lies with the provincial commissioners, while the authority rests with the imperial court. Otherwise, we would have to suppose that, in this age when the state flourishes and outstanding men arise together, there are none of the caliber of Gong and Jia. I, in my ignorance, cannot believe this.

title: 嘉靖十三年福建鄉試錄
text:
君籲俊尊帝曰仁臣勵翼弼
直曰義士讓善敬應曰賢自
唐虞三代以至
今日雖其取人之法與得人之
効有不同而是道莫之有改
也
皇上聰明仁聖德化所被颯颯乎
===
洋洋乎所謂萬邦黎獻共惟
帝臣固千載一時矣今日之
役我同事者矢心公矣能無
迷眩乎較藝精矣能無頗好
乎掄拔雋矣能無遺漏乎有
一于此皆不可謂之義矧
國朝開設賢科寔準古鄉舉里
punctuated:
君籲俊尊帝，曰仁；臣勵翼弼直，曰義；士讓善敬應，曰賢。自唐虞三代以至今日，雖其取人之法與得人之効有不同，而是道莫之有改也。
皇上聰明仁聖，德化所被，颯颯乎，洋洋乎！所謂「萬邦黎獻，共惟帝臣」，固千載一時矣。今日之役，我同事者矢心公矣，能無迷眩乎？較藝精矣，能無頗好乎？掄拔雋矣，能無遺漏乎？有一于此，皆不可謂之義。矧國朝開設賢科，寔準古鄉舉里
translation_en:
For a ruler to summon outstanding men and honor the Lord on High is called benevolence; for ministers to exert themselves in assistance and offer upright counsel is called righteousness; for scholars to defer to others’ excellence and respond respectfully is called worthiness. From the ages of Tang and Yu and the Three Dynasties down to the present, although methods of selecting men and success in obtaining worthy men have differed, this Way has never changed.
His Majesty is discerning, benevolent, and sagely. Wherever his transforming virtue reaches, how stirring [?], how vast it is! As the saying goes, “The many worthy men of the myriad states are all servants of the emperor.” Truly, this is an opportunity encountered once in a thousand years. In the present examination, we who serve together have pledged ourselves to impartiality; yet can we be free from confusion? We have assessed the candidates’ compositions meticulously; yet can we be free from partiality? We have selected outstanding talent; yet can we be free from omissions? If any one of these faults occurs, our conduct cannot be called righteous. Moreover, in establishing examinations for worthy men, our dynasty has indeed modeled itself upon the ancient system of district recommendation and village …

title: 嘉靖十三年福建鄉試錄
text:
選之法期得眞才以輔成至
治不徒取其言而已爾諸士
積學蓄德濟濟奮興蔚爲時
賢固非徒言云者然靜言庸
違擧平生而棄之者世蓋未
嘗無其人也槩之曰賢也可
乎哉吾於是不能不爲諸士
===
念且懼也嗟夫八閩文獻甲
天下若游酢楊時劉韐呂祉
李綱眞德秀其選也至于考
亭朱子則又上繼孔孟之傳
爲吾道宗主言而非誇出而
有獲大賢舉蹈於今爲烈諸
士非閩產乎君子固志其大
punctuated:
選之法，期得眞才，以輔成至治，不徒取其言而已。爾諸士積學蓄德，濟濟奮興，蔚爲時賢，固非徒言云者。然靜言庸違，擧平生而棄之者，世蓋未嘗無其人也。槩之曰賢也，可乎哉？吾於是不能不爲諸士念且懼也。
嗟夫！八閩文獻甲天下，若游酢、楊時、劉韐、呂祉、李綱、眞德秀，其選也。至于考亭朱子，則又上繼孔孟之傳，爲吾道宗主。言而非誇，出而有獲，大賢舉蹈於今爲烈。諸士非閩產乎？君子固志其大
translation_en:
…the method of selection, seeking men of genuine ability to help bring about consummate governance, rather than merely selecting them for their words. You scholars have accumulated learning and cultivated virtue; in impressive numbers you rise to the occasion, becoming an illustrious company of worthy men of the age. Surely you are not men of mere words. Yet the world has never lacked men who speak well at their ease but act contrary to their words, casting aside everything they have cultivated throughout their lives. Can they all indiscriminately be called worthy? Thus I cannot help feeling both concern and apprehension for you scholars.
Alas! The Eight Min regions of Fujian lead the realm in cultural learning and worthy men. You Zuo, Yang Shi, Liu Ge, Lü Zhi, Li Gang, and Zhen Dexiu are among their finest. As for Master Zhu of Kaoting, he further carried forward the transmission of Confucius and Mencius and became the leading authority of our Way. Their words were no empty boasts; when they came forward to serve, they achieved results. The conduct of these great worthies remains an illustrious example today [?]. Are you scholars not also natives of Fujian? The gentleman surely sets his aspirations upon what is great…

title: 嘉靖十三年福建鄉試錄
text:
者爾雖然
聖作物覩諸士之時固非游楊諸
君子之時比矣充其道雖追
夔契而上之可也豈直閩之
士而已乎玆則無負于玆賢
書而實執事者之所深望也
已
===
山東濟南府德州儒學學正
孫良德謹序
punctuated:
者爾。雖然，聖作物覩，諸士之時固非游楊諸君子之時比矣。充其道，雖追夔契而上之，可也。豈直閩之士而已乎？玆則無負于玆賢書，而實執事者之所深望也已。
山東濟南府德州儒學學正孫良德謹序。
translation_en:
…greater aims, that is all. Nevertheless, the sage has arisen, and all beings behold him: the age in which you scholars live is assuredly beyond comparison with that of You Zuo, Yang Shi, and those other gentlemen. If you fully develop your Way, you may even rival Kui and Xie and surpass them. How could you be merely scholars of Fujian? Thus you would do justice to this register of worthy men; this is indeed the earnest hope of those administering the examination.
Preface respectfully written by Sun Liangde, School Instructor at the Confucian School of Dezhou, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong.

title: 嘉靖十三年福建鄉試錄
